from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case (appellant, appellee, defendant, etc.)."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party")
    role: str = Field(description="Role of the party in this instance (e.g. 上诉人，被上诉人，原审被告)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A fee charge mentioned in the judgment."""
    fee_type: str = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g. 案件受理费，保全费)")
    amount: float = Field(description="Amount of the fee")
    payer: str = Field(description="Who pays the fee")
    note: str = Field(description="Any additional notes on the fee, e.g. already paid")

class Court(BaseModel):
    """The court handling the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the court")
    level: str = Field(description="Level of court (e.g. 一审，二审)", default="")

class Ruling(BaseModel):
    """A specific ruling decision item in the judgment."""
    action: str = Field(description="Action taken (e.g. 维持原判，驳回上诉，赔偿)")
    target: str = Field(description="Target of the action (e.g. 一审判决，某公司)")
    details: str = Field(description="Additional details of the ruling")

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    # Unique Identifiers
    case_number: Optional[str] = Field(description="The case number of the document (e.g. （2022）粤0112民初30517号)")
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the court that issued the judgment")
    court_level: str = Field(description="Whether this is 一审，二审，etc.")
    
    # Parties
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved with their names and roles")
    
    # Key Facts
    case_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of case (e.g. 民事，刑事，行政)")
    summary: str = Field(description="Short summary of the case facts and dispute")
    
    # Ruling & Outcome
    final_outcome: str = Field(description="The final disposition (e.g. 驳回上诉，维持原判)")
    rulings: list[Ruling] = Field(description="Detailed items of the verdict")
    
    # Financials (Critical for matching fee-heavy results)
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of fee assessments")
    compensation_amounts: list[float] = Field(description="List of specific amounts ordered to be paid")
    
    # Verification
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt confirming the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
